name: wisp

scripts.type-check: pnpm -r type-check && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.examples.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.react-tests.json
scripts.test: vitest run && pnpm test:react && pnpm test:release
scripts.build:examples: vite build examples/vanilla && vite build examples/vue-custom && vite build examples/vue-ready-made && vite build examples/react-ready-made
scripts.format: prettier --write shared packages tests examples scripts README.md docs *.json *.ts *.yaml
scripts.lint: prettier --check shared packages tests examples scripts README.md docs *.json *.ts *.yaml
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm type-check && pnpm test && pnpm build:examples
scripts.release:prepare: pnpm check && pnpm verify:packages && node scripts/release.mjs --check

author: Southneuhof contributors
description: Wisp: plug-and-play CloudflareOS integration for your app.
